notes: LoRA strength typos can't kill photos anymore. fal rejects strengths above 4 outright, which sent the whole photo to the GLM fallback (wrong face, strict content rules); values now clamp into range before sending, and the strength field is labeled with the sane 0–2 range. If a Civitai LoRA download fails with a 401, append your Civitai API token to its URL — the log names the failing URL.
